add_note.name: add_note
add_note.description: Adds an internal note to a conversation.

websiteId.description: You can obtain website ID by navigating to Settings -> Workspace Settings -> Setup & Integrations.

sessionId.description: You can obtain session from URL address bar.It starts with 'session_'.

aiMetadata.description: Appends an internal operator-only note message to an existing Crisp conversation, identified by website ID and conversation session ID. Use to record private context the customer cannot see. Not idempotent: each call posts a new note.

websiteId.description: You can obtain website ID by navigating to Settings -> Workspace Settings -> Setup & Integrations.

aiMetadata.description: Starts a new Crisp conversation in a website inbox: ensures the customer profile exists (upserted by email), creates an empty conversation, posts the first message (sent as either user or operator), and attaches the customer email/nickname to it. Use to open a fresh support thread. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate conversation.

create_update_contact.name: create_update_contact
create_update_contact.description: Creates a new contact or updates an existing contact.

websiteId.description: You can obtain website ID by navigating to Settings -> Workspace Settings -> Setup & Integrations.

aiMetadata.description: Upserts a person profile in a Crisp website by email: updates the existing contact if one matches, otherwise creates it. Use to keep contact details (name, phone, address, company, website, notepad) in sync. Idempotent: keyed on the stable email, so repeating with the same input yields the same contact.

change_state.name: change_state
change_state.description: Updates the state of a conversation.

websiteId.description: You can obtain website ID by navigating to Settings -> Workspace Settings -> Setup & Integrations.

sessionId.description: You can obtain session from URL address bar.It starts with 'session_'.

aiMetadata.description: Sets the workflow state of a Crisp conversation (unresolved, resolved, or pending), identified by website ID and conversation session ID. Use to mark a thread resolved or reopen it. Idempotent: re-applying the same target state leaves the conversation in that state with no extra effect.

find_conversation.name: find_conversation
find_conversation.description: Searches for conversations matching the specified criteria.

websiteId.description: You can obtain website ID by navigating to Settings -> Workspace Settings -> Setup & Integrations.

aiMetadata.description: Text-searches conversations in a Crisp website and returns the first page of matches. Use to locate an existing thread (and its session ID) before acting on it. Requires both the website ID and a non-empty search query. Idempotent: a read-only search with no side effects.

find_user_profile.name: find_user_profile
find_user_profile.description: Finds a user profile by email address.

websiteId.description: You can obtain website ID by navigating to Settings -> Workspace Settings -> Setup & Integrations.

email.description: The email address of the user to find.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single person profile in a Crisp website by exact email address, returning a found flag rather than erroring when no match exists. Use to check whether a contact already exists or to fetch its details. Idempotent: a read-only lookup with no side effects.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_contact.name: new_contact
new_contact.description: Triggers when a new contact is added.

websiteId.description: You can obtain website ID by navigating to Settings -> Workspace Settings -> Setup & Integrations.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new person profile is created in the selected Crisp website. Polls the people-profiles list on a schedule and emits each newly added contact.

new_conversation.name: new_conversation
new_conversation.description: Triggers when a new conversation is started.

websiteId.description: You can obtain website ID by navigating to Settings -> Workspace Settings -> Setup & Integrations.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new conversation is started in the selected Crisp website inbox. Polls the conversations list on a schedule and emits each newly created conversation.
